A reply to the ADT-02 Notice has been submitted by our Company via e-mail dated May 3, 2024. On May 7, 2024, our Company received an intimation of tax ascertained under section 73 of the Central Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017 / the Maharashtra Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017 in form GST DRC-01A from the Deputy Commissioner partially accepting our reply to ADT-02 Notice revising the amount of tax / interest / penalty payable by our Company from ₹ 20.20 million to ₹ 19.67 million. Further, our Company received form GST DRC-01 from the Deputy Commissioner on May 21, 2024, with an updated tax and other dues payable by our Company amounting to ₹ 19.80 million
